basic_details.job_title: SBI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 20 Data Scientist, Chief Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: State Bank of India (SBI) has 20 regular Specialist Cadre Officer vacancies for Data Scientists: 2 Chief Manager (Data Scientist), 14 Manager (Data Scientist) and 4 Deputy Manager (Data Scientist), under Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/31. Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech or a listed postgraduate degree with at least 60% marks, plus AI/ML experience of 3 to 6 years depending on the post. Indian citizens can register and pay the fee online on sbi.bank.in from 20 November 2026 to 10 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Post Age Limit (as on 31.10.2026) Chief Manager (Data Scientist) Minimum 27 years, maximum 37 years Manager (Data Scientist) Minimum 26 years, maximum 36 years Deputy Manager (Data Scientist) Minimum 24 years, maximum 32 years | The maximum age shown is for Unreserved category candidates. Relaxation in the upper age limit (wherever applicable): | Category Relaxation OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years SC/ST 5 years PwBD (UR/EWS) 10 years PwBD (OBC) 13 years PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years | Cumulative age relaxation is not available. OBC candidates in the creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation and must apply as UR or UR (PwBD). PwBD reservation is only for persons with not less than 40% of a specified disability, with a disability certificate dated on or before the last date of registration. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

qualification.details: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science / IT /Electronics / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Communication/Data Science/ AI & ML or equivalent degree in above disciplines/ M Sc Data Science / M Sc (Statistics/Computer Science)/MA (Statistics)/M Stat /MCA from recognized University/ Institution. Minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade in both Graduation / Post Graduation. | The prescribed qualification is the minimum. If a degree certificate does not show the specialisation, the candidate must produce a certificate from the university or college mentioning it.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online through the link on the SBI careers page (sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings). Hard copies need not be sent. The process, as the notice gives it:
Go to https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings, scroll down and open advertisement no. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/31.
Register online and note down the provisional registration number and password; a saved application can be edited three times only.
Upload the photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression and hand-written declaration, and capture a live photograph through webcam or mobile phone.
Upload the required documents as PDF files (A4 page size, not more than 500 kb each).
Choose one examination centre, if applicable.
Pay the fee online through the payment gateway (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/UPI etc.); no change is allowed after payment.
Print and keep the e-receipt and system-generated application form.
Registration is complete only when the fee is paid on or before 10 December 2026.
The fee is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted for any other examination or selection. Transaction charges are borne by the candidate.
Recent photograph (20–50 kb, 200 x 230 pixels preferred) and signature (10–20 kb, 140 x 60 pixels, not in capital letters)
Left-hand thumb impression on white paper in black or blue ink (240 x 240 pixels, 20–50 kb)
Hand-written declaration in English in black ink (800 x 400 pixels, 50–100 kb, not in capital letters)
Biodata (format attached) and Resume
ID proof and proof of date of birth
Educational certificates: relevant mark-sheets/degree certificate
Experience certificates
Caste certificate/EWS certificate and PwBD certificate (if applicable)
Preferred qualification/certification (if any)
Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary slip from current employer

The text of the declaration is: "I________ (Name of the candidate), _______ (Date of Birth) hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required. The signature, photograph and left-hand thumb impression is of mine".
important_instructions: Candidates are not allowed to apply for more than one post. With multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application is retained and other fees are forfeited. Call letters for the online test (with an "Acquaint Yourself" booklet) are downloaded from the Bank's website; interview call letters are uploaded or sent by email. No hard copy is sent. At the exam, bring one original photo ID (Passport/Aadhar/PAN Card/Driving License/Voter's Card/Bank Passbook with attested photograph) and a self-attested photocopy to submit with the call letter. Employees of Govt./Quasi Govt. offices, PSUs, Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate at the interview; otherwise candidature is not considered and travelling expenses are not paid. OBC candidates need a non-creamy layer certificate issued between 01.04.2026 and the date of interview; EWS candidates need an Income & Asset Certificate based on FY 2025-26 income, valid for 2026-27. Outstation candidates called for interview after shortlisting get economy air fare by the shortest route: up to Rs. 15,000 for Chief Manager and up to Rs. 10,000 for Manager and Deputy Manager (total for both sides), or actual fare, whichever is lower. Candidates found ineligible at the interview are not interviewed and get no travel reimbursement. Selected candidates must produce a discharge certificate from the current employer at joining, and appointment depends on medical fitness and verification of antecedents. Mobile phones, smartwatches, pagers and calculators are not allowed in the exam or interview premises. The Bank may capture IRIS scans and thumb impressions; candidates should not apply mehandi, ink or chemicals on their hands. Updates, results and shortlists are posted only on the Bank's website. Queries go through "CONTACT US/ Post Your Query" at https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/post-your-query. Legal disputes fall under the courts at Mumbai alone.

content_sections.heading: About SBI
content_sections.text: State Bank of India is a public sector bank. This recruitment is conducted by its Central Recruitment & Promotion Department at the Corporate Centre, Mumbai. The Data Scientist posts work on the Bank's AI platform, covering AI architecture, Generative and Agentic AI, MLOps and LLMOps, AI security, quality testing, front-end and integration work for enterprise banking.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: SBI has notified 20 vacancies across three grades. Some reserved and PwBD vacancies are marked as backlog in the notice. The vacancies, including reserved vacancies, are provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement of the Bank. PwBD reservation is horizontal and is included in the vacancies of the respective parent category. VI means Visually Impaired and HI means Hearing Impaired. Reserved category and PwBD candidates for whom no reservation is shown may apply against Unreserved vacancies if they meet all the Unreserved eligibility criteria.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens can apply. Eligibility (qualification, certifications and experience) is counted as on 31.10.2026. B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science / IT /Electronics / Electrical & Electronics / Electronics & Communication/Data Science/ AI & ML or equivalent degree in above disciplines/ M Sc Data Science / M Sc (Statistics/Computer Science)/MA (Statistics)/M Stat /MCA from recognized University/ Institution. Minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade in both Graduation / Post Graduation. The prescribed qualification is the minimum. If a degree certificate does not show the specialisation, the candidate must produce a certificate from the university or college mentioning it. Training and teaching experience is not counted for eligibility. The experience certificate must clearly show the nature of duties, dates and duration, level or position and responsibilities. If such a certificate is not available, any document clearly showing the experience, duties and period may be submitted; the Bank will consider it on merit and its decision is final. Chief Manager (Data Scientist) – one of two tracks: Agentic AI Architecture: end-to-end architecture for production-grade LLM, RAG and agentic AI solutions; secure solutions for on-premises, private-cloud or controlled enterprise environments; architecture governance and production readiness; domain experience in banking, document intelligence, risk and compliance, lending, workflow automation or knowledge management. OR AI Quality Assurance – Testing: leading multidisciplinary testing teams; defining test strategies, quality gates and release-readiness standards; testing AI/ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications. Manager (Data Scientist) – one of six tracks: Gen AI / Agentic AI: deploying AI apps in enterprise/on-prem/private-cloud environments; exposure to conversational banking, document intelligence, risk & fraud, lending, workflow automation. OR MLOps: model versioning, release, monitoring, rollback, recalibration, retirement; CI/CD and MLOps platforms. OR LLM Ops: model/prompt/config/evaluation versioning; automated evaluation, guardrails, observability, incident management. OR AI Security & Governance: AI/ML/LLM/Agent security and risk assessment; threat modelling, control testing, incident handling, audit support. OR DevSecOps: secure CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines; containers, Kubernetes, IaC, vulnerability and release management. OR AI Quality: testing AI/ML/GenAI/Agentic systems; test plans, cases, data, traceability and validation evidence. Deputy Manager (Data Scientist) – one of two tracks: Front end: modern web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks; integrating REST APIs and authentication services; responsive design and accessibility; dashboards and decision-support interfaces. OR Integration (EIS/MuleSoft): enterprise integrations using APIs or integration platforms; integrating core systems, data platforms, digital channels and AI/ML services; synchronous, async

rows.mandatory_experience: Minimum 6 years post qualification experience in AI/ML, of which 2+ years in scalable, python based LLM/GenAI/Agentic AI Applications.
rows.preferred_certifications: AI Architecture – TOGAF or equivalent OR AI Quality and testing – ISTQB or equivalent.

rows.mandatory_experience: Overall 4+ years post-qualification experience in AI/ML, of which 2+ years in Python-based LLM / GenAI / Agentic AI solutions at scale.
rows.preferred_certifications: Certifications in Gen AI/Agentic AI OR MLOps OR LLMOps OR AI Security & Governance OR DevSecOps OR AI Quality & testing from recognized universities/institutions.

rows.mandatory_experience: 3 years overall experience after basic qualification, of which minimum 2+ years full-time in Analytics / AI / ML / GenAI; and minimum 1+ year full-time experience developing AI/ML/Deep Learning/GenAI models.
rows.preferred_certifications: Flutter / Angular / React or equivalent OR Mulesoft or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: For all three posts, the official will be eligible for DA, HRA, CCA, PF, Contributory Pension Fund (NPS), LFC, Medical Facility, leave etc. as per rules in force from time to time, and salary and perks as per the Bank's salary structure. Appointments are made at the starting stage of the pay scale. The notice does not mention the in-hand salary. The appointments are on regular basis. Selected candidates will be on probation as per the Bank's extant recruitment policy and will be governed by the Service Rules applicable to SBI employees. The suggested place of posting is Mumbai or anywhere in India in case of any administrative requirement, and the Bank may also depute officers to its associates, subsidiaries or other organisations.

content_sections.heading: SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice says these roles are illustrative; actual KRAs are assigned on joining and the Bank may assign other work. AI Architecture: Define end-to-end architecture, technology strategy, reusable patterns and governance standards for LLM, RAG, conversational AI, document intelligence and agentic workflows. Architect secure model gateways, orchestration layers, knowledge services, APIs, vector stores and model-serving components. Establish LLMOps for versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, controlled releases and production readiness. Embed security, privacy, responsible-AI governance, lineage, metadata and access controls; ensure enterprise-scale performance, GPU utilization and cost efficiency. KRAs: scalable AI architecture for enterprise-wide initiatives, periodic upgrades, a future-ready architecture loosely coupled with vendors/OEMs, and a roadmap sized for several lakh users. OR AI Quality and Testing: Lead QA strategy, risk-based test planning, acceptance criteria, traceability and release-readiness. Drive testing for ML, generative AI, LLM and agentic AI, including accuracy, groundedness, safety, bias, latency and permissions. Build reusable automation, evaluation datasets, regression suites and CI/CD-integrated testing; govern defects and root-cause analysis. Evaluate models, platforms and vendor solutions; coordinate production-readiness reviews and controlled releases. KRAs: test coverage, defect leakage, quality-gate compliance, automation ratio, release readiness and timely defect closure. Gen AI/Agentic AI: design, develop, deploy and operate secure, scalable AI, ML, GenAI, LLM and agentic-AI solutions for enterprise banking; build RAG pipelines, conversational systems, document-intelligence workflows, inference APIs, agents and knowledge bases. OR MLOps/LLMOps: implement CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps practices; operate production pipelines on the Bank's on-premises AI platform for performance, GPU utilization and cost optimization. OR AI Security & Governance: risk assessments, security reviews, threat modelling, adversarial testing and AI governance checks; guardrails, access controls and audit trails; compliance with RBI frameworks and Bank policies. OR DevSecOps: integrate SAST, DAST, dependency and container security, infrastructure-as-code validation and automated compliance. OR AI Quality Assurance – Testing: functional, integration, performance, security and AI-specific tests including bias, groundedness and explainability; maintain dashboards, defect logs and production-readiness evidence. Front end: design, develop, test and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces for enterprise and AI-driven applications; convert UX/UI designs into reusable components; build interfaces for conversational AI, knowledge assistants, dashboards and agentic workflows; optimise rendering, load time and caching. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A shortlisting committee of the Bank decides the shortlisting parameters and calls an adequate number of candidates for interview. The interview carries 100 marks; qualifying marks are decided by the Bank. The merit list is prepared on interview scores only. The online written test will be held tentatively in December 2026/January 2027. The Bank reserves the right to dispense with the written examination and adopt shortlisting and interview instead. *The General Aptitude papers are qualifying; their marks are not counted for merit, and the minimum qualifying marks are decided (or may be waived) by the Bank. There are no negative marks for wrong answers. To be shortlisted for interview, candidates must score at or above the Professional Knowledge cut-off, besides qualifying in the other papers; category-wise candidates are called on written test performance. The interview carries 100 marks, and the final merit list is based on normalized written test and interview marks with 70:30 weightage. Professional Knowledge paper – Manager (Data Scientist): Programming, Data Structures & Machine Learning Fundamentals (10 questions, 17 marks); Generative AI, LLMs, RAG & Agentic AI (12, 20); MLOps, LLMOps & DevSecOps (12, 20); AI Security, Governance & Responsible AI (9, 15); Software Testing & AI Quality Engineering (7, 11); Cloud, Infrastructure, Databases, Networking & Security Basics (10, 17). Professional Knowledge paper – Deputy Manager (Data Scientist): Programming, Data Science & Machine Learning Fundamentals (15 questions, 25 marks); Generative AI, RAG & Agentic AI Fundamentals (20, 33); Application Development, APIs & Integration Basics (15, 25); Security, Testing, Cloud & Deployment Basics (10, 17). The notice gives a detailed indicative syllabus for both papers. Tentative test centres: Guwahati, Silchar, Patna, Mohali, Raipur, Delhi/New Delhi/NCR, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Gurugram, Mapusa, Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar, Vadodara/Anand, Ambala, Hamirpur (HP), Jammu, Srinagar, Shimla, Bilaspur (HP), Jamshedpur, Ranchi, Bengaluru, Hubli/Dharwad, Mangalore, Ernakulam, Thiruvananthapuram, Bhopal, Indore, Mumbai/Thane/Navi Mumbai/MMR, Nagpur, Pune, Imphal, Shillong, Aizawl, Kohima, Bhubaneshwar, Puducherry, Jaipur, Udaipur, Gangtok, Chennai, Madurai, Hyderabad, Agartala, Lucknow, Kolkata and Siliguri. The choice of centre cannot be changed; the Bank may allot another centre.
